summary: Introduces ansible-creator for scaffolding collection projects, available via the Ansible Development Tools package, used through its init subcommand or the VS Code Ansible extension.
questions: Is there a tool to scaffold a collection project faster than ansible-galaxy init?
Can I create a collection from inside VS Code?

answer_card.title: Scaffold collections with ansible-creator
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible-creator` scaffolds collection projects. Install it via the **Ansible Development Tools** package, then use `ansible-creator init` or the Ansible extension for VS Code.
